outcome: resolution of cesarean section scar pregnancy (CSSP)

cohort: A 27-year-old woman diagnosed with a cesarean section scar pregnancy.
finding: Multidose methotrexate treatment for cesarean section scar pregnancy can lead to a successful outcome, followed by a subsequent successful pregnancy and neonatal outcome.
